newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Fewer Zaire refugees flee to Tanzania.
newsitem.headline: Fewer Zaire refugees flee to Tanzania.

text.p: The number of Zairean refugees fleeing to Tanzania to escape fighting in east Zaire has halved to around 500 per day, the U.N. refugee agency said on Wednesday.
"It's dropped drastically to around 500 (per day). There's a lull," said John Adu, head of UNHCR's office in Kigoma, western Tanzania.
Adu said a total of 85,354 Zairean refugees had crossed Lake Tanganyika to Tanzania since fighting between Zairean rebels and the government army began last October.
Temporary detention centres in Kigoma town hold 10,557 Zaireans, while camps in Kigoma region hold 259,540 Zairean and Burundian refugees, Adu said.
Last month around 1,000 Zaireans per day were crossing into Tanzania.
